name: site-go-live
title: Site Go Live
description: TSD's full go-live checklist for launching a website: pre-launch checks, DNS, server and source code changes, third-party services, content, SEO, testing, security, performance and post-launch tasks.

Ensure permissions are correct on the Umbraco folder
subtasks.description:
Ensure permissions are correct on the Umbraco folder (they should be). Here's my PowerShell script I use: https://gist.github.com/timgaunt/9933156

**Powershell script to set permissions**
```
$PhysicalPath = "[Path to Website]"
$appPoolAccount = "IIS_IUSRS"
$readExecute = $appPoolAccount,"ReadAndExecute","ContainerInherit, ObjectInherit","InheritOnly","Allow"
$read = $appPoolAccount,"Read","ContainerInherit, ObjectInherit","InheritOnly","Allow"
$modify = $appPoolAccount,"Modify","ContainerInherit, ObjectInherit","InheritOnly","Allow"
$fileModify = $appPoolAccount,"Modify","Allow"
$objects = @{}
$objects["app_browsers"] = $readExecute
$objects["app_code"] = $readExecute
$objects["app_data"] = $modify
$objects["bin"] = $read
$objects["config"] = $modify
$objects["css"] = $modify
$objects["macroscripts"] = $modify
$objects["masterpages"] = $modify
$objects["media"] = $modify
$objects["scripts"] = $modify
$objects["umbraco"] = $modify
$objects["usercontrols"] = $modify
$objects["views"] = $modify
$objects["xslt"] = $modify
$objects["web.config"] = $fileModify
foreach($object in $objects.Keys) {
    $path = Join-Path $PhysicalPath $object
    $acl = Get-ACL $path
    $rule = New-Object System.Security.AccessControl.FileSystemAccessRule($objects[$object])
    $acl.AddAccessRule($rule)
    Set-Acl $path $acl
    Get-Acl $path | Format-List
}
```

subtasks.title: Setup URL rewriting (web.config should point to a rewrite.config and rewritemaps.config)
subtasks.description:
There are a few changes you need to make if they've not already been done:

* 1. Add the rewrite node to the end of the system.webServer node in web.config*

**web.config**
```
<rewrite>
	<rules configSource="App_Data\Rewrite.config" />
	<rewriteMaps configSource="App_Data\RewriteMaps.config" />
</rewrite>
```

* 2. Add a Rewrite.config file to App_Data*

**App_Data\Rewrite.config**
```
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<rules>
	<clear />
	<rule name="Canonical Hostname" stopProcessing="true" enabled="true">
		<match url="(.*)" />
		<conditions>
			<add input="{HTTP_HOST}" pattern="^[## REPLACE WITH DOMAIN ESCAPED NAME i.e. \.com not .com]$" negate="true" />
		</conditions>
		<action type="Redirect" url="http://[## REPLACE WITH DOMAIN NAME]/{ToLower:{R:1}}" />
	</rule>
	<rule name="Ignore Umbraco folders" stopProcessing="true">
		<match url="umbraco.+" />
		<conditions logicalGrouping="MatchAll" trackAllCaptures="false" />
		<action type="None" />
	</rule>
	<rule name="Ignore Umbraco Urls" stopProcessing="true">
		<match url="(\d{4,5})\.aspx" />
		<conditions logicalGrouping="MatchAll" trackAllCaptures="false" />
		<action type="None" />
	</rule>
	<rule name="Ignore protected folders" stopProcessing="true">
		<match url="(webservices|umbraco|usercontrols|css|img|images|media|xslt)/(.+)" />
		<conditions logicalGrouping="MatchAll" trackAllCaptures="false" />
		<action type="None" />
	</rule>
	<rule name="Ignore Image/Script/CSS Calls" stopProcessing="true">
		<match url=".+\.(jpg|jpeg|png|css|js|gif|axd|ico)*" />
		<conditions logicalGrouping="MatchAll" trackAllCaptures="false" />
		<action type="None" />
	</rule>
	<rule name="Add Trailing Slash" stopProcessing="true">
		<match url="(.*[^/])$" />
		<conditions logicalGrouping="MatchAll" trackAllCaptures="false">
			<add input="{REQUEST_FILENAME}" matchType="IsDirectory" negate="true" />
			<add input="{REQUEST_FILENAME}" matchType="IsFile" negate="true" />
			<add input="{REQUEST_FILENAME}" pattern="(.*)\.html$" negate="true" />
		</conditions>
		<action type="Redirect" url="{R:1}/" />
	</rule>
	<rule name="Lower Case Url" stopProcessing="true">
		<match url="[A-Z]" ignoreCase="false" />
		<conditions logicalGrouping="MatchAll" trackAllCaptures="false" />
		<action type="Redirect" url="{ToLower:{URL}}" />
	</rule>
	<rule name="General Rewrites" stopProcessing="true" enabled="true">
		<match url=".*" />
		<conditions logicalGrouping="MatchAll" trackAllCaptures="false">
			<add input="{General:{REQUEST_URI}}" pattern="(.+)" />
		</conditions>
		<action type="Redirect" url="{C:1}" appendQueryString="true" />
	</rule>
</rules>
```

* 3. Add a RewriteMaps.config file to App_Data*

**App_Data\RewriteMaps.config**
```
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<rewriteMaps>
 	<rewriteMap name="General">
		<add key="" value="" />
	</rewriteMap>
</rewriteMaps>
```

Remember that if you modify Rewrite.config or RewriteMaps.config without modifying the web.config then you will need to "touch" the web.config to reload the settings.

One thing to note is if the old files had file extensions e.g. ".html" or ".php", the "Add Trailing Slash" rule will need to be updated with an additional rule that ignores urls with that extension as "IsDirectory" and "IsFile" check if the file/directory actually exist on the disk.

```
<rule name="Add Trailing Slash" stopProcessing="true">
	<match url="(.*[^/])$" />
	<conditions logicalGrouping="MatchAll" trackAllCaptures="false">
		<add input="{REQUEST_FILENAME}" matchType="IsDirectory" negate="true" />
		<add input="{REQUEST_FILENAME}" matchType="IsFile" negate="true" />
		<add input="{REQUEST_FILENAME}" pattern="(.*)\.html$" negate="true" />
	</conditions>
	<action type="Redirect" url="{R:1}/" />
</rule>
```

Add caching to web.config for the static content folders
subtasks.description:
We need to leverage the browser caching on the folders that contain static content i.e. images, fonts, css and scripts.

If there's already a web.config, we need to add staticContent to the system.webServer node, if not, create a new web.config file:

```
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<configuration>
	<system.webServer>
		<staticContent>
			<clientCache cacheControlMode="UseMaxAge" cacheControlMaxAge="30.00:00:00" />
		</staticContent>
	</system.webServer>
</configuration>
```

Add httpCompression and urlCompression to web.config
subtasks.description:
httpCompression and urlCompression nodes will need to be added to the end of the system.webServer node in the web.config if they're not already there

**web.config**
```
<httpCompression directory="%SystemDrive%\inetpub\temp\IIS Temporary Compressed Files">
    <scheme name="gzip" dll="%Windir%\system32\inetsrv\gzip.dll" />
    <dynamicTypes>
        <add mimeType="text/*" enabled="true" />
        <add mimeType="message/*" enabled="true" />
        <add mimeType="application/javascript" enabled="true" />
        <add mimeType="*/*" enabled="false" />
    </dynamicTypes>
    <staticTypes>
        <add mimeType="text/*" enabled="true" />
        <add mimeType="message/*" enabled="true" />
        <add mimeType="application/javascript" enabled="true" />
        <add mimeType="*/*" enabled="false" />
    </staticTypes>
</httpCompression>
<urlCompression doStaticCompression="true" doDynamicCompression="true" />
```

subtasks.title: Update the log4net.config settings
subtasks.description:
This may change depending on the site we're running but this is our standard log4net.config setup:

```
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<log4net>
	<root>
		<priority value="Info"/>
		<appender-ref ref="AsynchronousLog4NetAppender" />
	</root>

	<appender name="AsynchronousLog4NetAppender" type="Umbraco.Core.Logging.AsynchronousRollingFileAppender, Umbraco.Core">
		<file value="App_Data\Logs\UmbracoTraceLog.txt" />
		<lockingModel type="log4net.Appender.FileAppender+MinimalLock" />
		<appendToFile value="true" />
		<rollingStyle value="Date" />
		<maximumFileSize value="5MB" />
		<layout type="log4net.Layout.PatternLayout">
			<conversionPattern value="%date [%thread] %-5level %logger - %message%newline" />
		</layout>
		<encoding value="utf-8" />
	</appender>

	<logger name="System.Object">
		<level value="Warn" />
	</logger>
	<logger name="SeqAppender">
		<level value="Debug" />
		<appender-ref ref="Umbraco" />
	</logger>
	<logger name="umbraco.macro">
		<level value="Info" />
	</logger>
	<logger name="Umbraco.Web.UmbracoModule">
		<level value="Info" />
	</logger>
	<logger name="Umbraco.Core">
		<level value="Info" />
	</logger>
	<logger name="Umbraco.Web.Routing">
		<level value="Info" />
	</logger>
	<logger name="Raven">
		<level value="ERROR" />
	</logger>
	<logger name="NHibernate">
		<level value="ERROR" />
	</logger>
	<logger name="NHibernate.SQL">
		<level value="ERROR" />
	</logger>
</log4net>
```

subtasks.description: Ensure that any Forgotten Password form respond with a "Thank You" page (or similar message confirming that the process was successful)

subtasks.title: Forgotten Password form show helpful error message when no user is found
subtasks.description: Ensure that any Forgotten Password form respond with a helpful message when the user doesn't exist. It shouldn't say the user doesn't exist but instead just that if it's found we'll email them (so it doesn't identify valid usernames).

subtasks.title: Forgotten Password reset form show helpful message on successful reset

subtasks.description: When an invalid token has been supplied it should show some form of helpful error message asking them to go through the process again.

subtasks.description: The token to reset the password should expire after 24 hours. When using an expired token it should ask them to go through the process again.

subtasks.title: Forgotten Password reset form should correctly reset the user's password
Forgotten Password reset form should unlock the user
subtasks.description: When resetting the password the user may be locked (IsApproved = false in umbraco) so it should unlock the user and allow them to log in.

subtasks.title: Login form shows nice message when a wrong username is entered
subtasks.description: When entering an invalid username, the form should alert the user with a nice error message however the error message shouldn't specify whether it was either the username or the password i.e. something ambigous is best: `Sorry, no user could be found with that username or password. Please check your details and try again.`

subtasks.title: Login form shows nice message when a wrong password is entered
subtasks.description: When entering an invalid password, the form should alert the user with a nice error message however the error message shouldn't specify whether it was either the username or the password i.e. something ambigous is best: `Sorry, no user could be found with that username or password. Please check your details and try again.`

subtasks.title: Check all mailing list signup forms work (both that they respond with a "Thank You" page (or similar) and the email address is added to the relevant list)
Check both Site Maps work (XML & HTML)
Check XML sitemap exists
subtasks.description:
It's usually /xmlsitemap/ based on the template name.
When checking it is important to ensure that the <loc> tag includes a full and valid url including domain name. If the domain name is missing from the url, this will need to be updated by setting the "SiteUrl" on the "Homepage" node in Umbraco.
A good example is below:
<url>
	<loc>http://thesitedoctor.co.uk/</loc>;
	<lastmod>2015-06-23T14:04:43+00:00</lastmod>
	<changefreq>daily</changefreq>
	<priority>0.5</priority>
</url>

subtasks.title: Check HTML sitemap exists
subtasks.description: It's usually /sitemap/ but we should also have a link in the footer.

subtasks.title: Check hidden pages are hidden on the sitemaps
subtasks.description: Examples are the Category/Product template pages and checkout steps. These should be hidden on both Site Maps XML & HTML) -if they're not click "Hide From Navigation" on the "CMS" node

Check the rewriting adds -or removes the trailing /
subtasks.description:
Easiest way to check this is to go to any page on the site, once the page has loaded, remove the trailing slash and ensure that the url you're left with once the page has loaded has the trailing slash.
Also: hover over the menu links and ensure that the urls include the trailing /.
A complete test will mean reviewing the network traffic to ensure that you don't get a 301 redirect in the request.

Check site speed using Google's PageSpeed tests
subtasks.description:
Run through Google's PageSpeed tests (https://developers.google.com/speed/pagespeed/).

It will highlight the main issues (if any) that we need to resolve. It's a judgement call so address the ones that make send and overview why you haven't on the ones that you don't resolve i.e. "reducing the image by 1kb will have taken too long".

subtasks.title: Check that browser caching is in place and being used
subtasks.description:
Easiest thing to do is to run through Google's PageSpeed tests (https://developers.google.com/speed/pagespeed/). 

It will highlight a lot of offsite issues but if it reports that files in the css/fonts/img/media/scripts folders aren't leveraging browser caching then you'll need to check that the web.configs exist and httpCompression and urlCompression exist in the web.config

subtasks.title: Validate Open Graph settings
subtasks.description:
Easiest thing to do is to run through Facebook's Open Graph Object Debugger (https://developers.facebook.com/tools/debug/og/object/).

It will highlight many of the issues you may have. Best to Fetch new scrape information in case someone has run it before.
